mstts:express-as.prosody: As we wrap up, let’s take a moment to remember this— the story of artificial intelligence isn’t finished yet. It’s unfolding every day, and you’re a part of it. Sure, there’s a lot of uncertainty and plenty of big questions, but at its core, this is really about people—about the choices we make and the future we want to build together. So, if you’re wondering how to get started, here are a few things you can do right now: Every time you interact with AI, see it as a chance to show empathy and fairness. Ask for transparency from the tech you use—make sure you know how it works, and why. Get involved in conversations about AI in your community. Help others, especially kids, learn how to use technology thoughtfully. And when you can, support those companies and organizations that really care about ethical AI. Here’s what it all comes down to: The future isn’t locked in. It’s shaped by all the little choices we make, day after day. You don’t have to be an expert or a leader to make a real difference. Just care deeply, pay attention, and act with purpose. There’ll be tough moments, and times when it feels overwhelming. But history shows us that when people work together, they can change the world. The machines are learning from us—so let’s show them something worth learning. The future of AI, and honestly, the future of humanity, comes down to what we do right now. So step forward with courage and compassion. Help write the next chapter. The world is waiting.
